card.name: Last digit of numbers in ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 0 or 9, that ends a number such as 10 or 90 or 59. It sits at the upper end of a range or in a dose or weight table.

modes.label: Range upper end
modes.description: The final 0 or 9 of the top number in a range such as 5 to 10 or 5-10.
